context_notes: This is a ship/deploy operation, not phase/spike/sketch/deliberation work — full plan with mechanics, gotchas, and a live progress log lives at /home/apedraza/.claude/plans/tranquil-sniffing-torvalds.md (read that file's 'PROGRESS LOG' section first, it is kept more current than this JSON). Key mechanical findings already discovered: (1) GitHub's pull_request CI checkout uses the merge-of-(PR-branch+base), so fixes already merged to main are inherited by later phase branches automatically as long as they don't touch the same lines — do not preemptively reapply PR 30/31's fixes to remaining branches. (2) required_status_checks.strict=true means every subsequent PR will need the update-branch API call before gh pr merge succeeds, since main advances between each PR's creation and merge. (3) mix.lock had real, currently-unpatched security advisories (igniter/mint/usage_rules) affecting current main too, not just historical commits — already fixed on main via PR 30, no further action needed there. (4) config/deploy.yml was missing R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL in its env.clear block since Phase 1 (unrelated pre-existing gap) — already fixed on main via PR 31, no further action needed.
